coverage: Covered all 18 shard entries (openspec/changes listing lines 19-36, all top-level dated dirs 2026-05-23..2026-06-01; no stray .json/.ts files and no archive entries in this slice). For every entry I read proposal.md in full and read the headings and checkbox counts of tasks.md, plus topology-discovery-loop/findings/dev.md. I skipped design.md and the specs/*/spec.md deltas. Live checks were read-only on substrate-live: grepped /workspace/git/vessels/*/src for each change's identifiers; counted per-activity rows in trace_digest since 2026-09-14 (activity_execution_traces only holds 18,135 July rows); checked the development-vessel /proc environ for WRITE_ALLOWLIST (key presence only); read development-vessel git log/show for fs-write.ts; grepped the journal for concept-bridge. I did not verify the git dates of commits 69d680b and bafd83d; they are known only from a code comment.

problems.symptom: A source fix is committed or edited into the clone, but the running process keeps the old binary. The fix is declared landed while its effective behavior is unchanged (F26 concept-db, cache fix 93cd621, EMBEDDING_MODEL_DIR).
problems.root_cause: No activity compares the running binary to the source and redeploys; the redeploy spec was never built; config paths (Dockerfile ENV vs gen-env) diverge.

problems.symptom: fs_write scoping is behind the WRITE_ALLOWLIST env var. A gap to remove the gate was 'closed' by at least 3 landings (69d680b, bafd83d rename, 6586f17 branch flip), yet the gate is intact and the var is unset live, so there is no scoping at all.
problems.root_cause: The spec chose an env knob (law 1). Close predicates certified on commit provenance rather than the effective condition. The outer guard makes the inner deny unreachable.

problems.symptom: After migration 118 the LIST reader returned task_count=0 for 491/500 rows. The phantom detector filed 50 false gaps, and a '9367 phantoms' claim propagated into specs and concepts.
problems.root_cause: The storage split updated one reader (single GET) and not its sibling (LIST).

problems.symptom: Events and resolutions were emitted where no consumer read them: engine lifecycle on an in-process sink, discovery registration emitting nothing (F-129: zero proxies), analysis resolutions not matching concept-db filters (145 events, 0 usage), /resolve dual-form parse drift across 3 vessels.
problems.root_cause: Producer/consumer contracts are re-derived per vessel, and no conformance detector exists for the class.

problems.symptom: Mechanisms were built and seeded but never reach or run: topology coverage-tick (S.4a never met, 0 traces since 09-14), ingest-doc (0% delta), draft-spec-from-gap, oom detector, obsidian writeback, closed-loop pattern detectors, and inert listeners with no emitter.
problems.root_cause: Acceptance was defined as code plus typecheck plus one dispatch, not as a sustained reached trace. Event-driven consumers shipped without producers.

problems.symptom: Acceptance was declared on producer-side evidence: concept-bridge 'fires' while concept-db rejects every write; a restart goal 'completed' via an unrelated template; _goal_resolve failure_mode null ×12 explained away.
problems.root_cause: No positive control at the consuming layer, and status was read instead of reach.

problems.symptom: tasks.md checkboxes are wrong in both directions: 4 live changes at 0% ticked, 3 mostly ticked but dormant. 8 of 18 changes are dead or superseded but not archived. Proposals reference removed paths (minibob, metabob-activity-api).
problems.root_cause: There is no archive/closure step tied to live verification, and openspec status is maintained by hand.

problems.symptom: Near-uniform draws among 3 templates for the same goal, and empty 10ms successes inflating α. The stagnation detector dropped the right template, and the fix bypassed the selector (templateId tasks). Cascading β attributed to depth-1 only.
problems.root_cause: Sparse n≈1 arms, success updates not discounted for information, credit attribution without a root_cause_step.

problems.symptom: goal-host grew to about 10GB and was OOM-killed every ~3 min, and the docker daemon wedged.
problems.root_cause: The fire-and-forget bus forwarder (05-27) had unbounded in-flight promises, plus a WS listener leak.

problems.symptom: The same two activities are minted as ≥6 distinct one-shot compositions (learned-topology-snapshot ↔ substrate-health-tick), plus reverse-named duplicate chains (90/84 executions).
problems.root_cause: Auto-mint does not dedupe by shape signature or composition edge set (law 3).

problems.symptom: recommit-recommit-…-narrowed gap ids three suffixes deep landed on fs-write.ts on 2026-08-30 (6586f17, 11ea1f6, 66bf1b8). Ribosome timestamp-variant ids caused template churn on 05-24.
problems.root_cause: Retries mint new gap and template identities instead of updating one.

problems.symptom: activity_execution_traces holds only July rows (18,135); recent traces are in trace_digest, execution_traces is empty, and trace_digest max(executed_at) aggregates return null.
problems.root_cause: Trace storage migrated or reclaimed; readers of AET may see a frozen world (not verified here).

problems.symptom: The test template gap-closing:test-valid-1780148026306 was selected for a real operator goal.
problems.root_cause: Test fixture templates were resident in the live selection pool.

problems.symptom: Concept vocabulary was minted only by operator hand. Docs, commits and memory were never ingested, and pointer coverage stayed at 0%.
problems.root_cause: The ingestion templates never got past the LLM step, and there was no management layer.

principles: Emitters broadcast neutrally; consumers register the hooks they need; no event is 'for' a consumer (2026-05-27-neutral-emitter-lifecycle-bus proposal §Why)
Substrate is deployment vocabulary: above discovery, callers see vessels, not topologies; no substrate_id (2026-05-23-vessel-federation §Explicit non-goals)

Ship the LOOP, not the LOG: detection and resolution are Thompson-graded activities gated by reversibility tiers, with push-away applied to the substrate's own resolutions (2026-05-31-substrate-fleet-federation §Observe, detect, resolve)
Hand-patching the instance short-circuits the signal; build the class detector and let the loop author fixes (2026-05-30-vessel-resolve-contract-conformance §Out of Scope)
Detector immunity pattern: inputShapes [], variables [], a single deterministic resolver; a meta must not become the next finding (2026-05-31-substrate-self-audit-meta §1; goal-host-oom §Layer 3)
Event-driven detection over rotation-stochastic detection: detection must arrive before the posterior absorbs the damage (substrate-self-audit-meta §Why)

Activity-layer authoring self-rolls-back via Thompson β; code-layer authoring does not (a no-op resolver accrues α), so code needs gates and attribution (2026-05-30-vessel-binary-redeploy §review separation)
The rollback target is the latest operator-ratified ancestor in a hash-chained manifest (vessel-binary-redeploy §Rollback discriminator)

Coverage progress means the unlearned and unknown cells strictly shrink and the learned cell grows without external goals; renamed from 'convergence' because the name overclaimed (2026-05-23-topology-discovery-loop §Coverage-progress)
Redundant successes should saturate: count-based novelty α += 1/(1+n), symmetric with failure stratification (2026-05-30-info-gain-bonus-on-success)
Failure credit belongs to the step that caused it (root_cause_step), not to depth-1 ancestors (2026-05-31-display-failure-mode-extensions §4)
Deployment-mechanism changes stay operator-controlled (trust root); each verifier version is anchored to its predecessor (2026-05-23-substrate-self-deployment §Self-application)
Replace, don't edit in place: shadow-validate against live traffic, promote on evidence, archive (2026-05-23-substrate-self-replacement-pipeline §Why)
The S2 win is deriving the next adapter, not re-deriving the hand-authored one (2026-05-28-concept-bridge-observer §S1→S2 evidence value)
Fix the canonical observability surface, not only the detector that tripped on it (2026-05-31-list-endpoint-task-count-from-content §Why fix in activity-api)
Anti-principle observed: shipping 'inert listeners so the contract is in place' produces consumers with no producer, which are dormant by construction (doc-ingestion Families 1/3; redeploy observer)
